messages.created.instructions:
Read the PixivDownloader OpenAPI document using the program key provided separately:
{0}
Send Authorization: Bearer <key> with every request. Before you start, call GET /api/security/program-keys/self to confirm this key’s permissions. A 401 or 403 response names the missing permission in its programPermission field. Use the documented endpoints to help me with my task within the permissions granted.
If you support Agent Skills, ask me before running npx skills add Sywyar/PixivDownloader --skill pixivdownloader -g to install the PixivDownloader skill. It describes the common endpoints and how to call them.
